## Details
### **SW-REQ-GPS-001** — Receive Raw NMEA Bytes from GPS Receiver

- **Description:** The GPS library shall receive raw NMEA byte data from the GPS receiver hardware interface.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-001 and SW-REQ-SYS-024; raw NMEA acquisition is the library's primary responsibility.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-024
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-002** — Verbatim Pass-Through of NMEA Sentences

- **Description:** The GPS library shall expose received NMEA sentences to the caller without modifying their byte content.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-024; verbatim raw NMEA logging requires the library not to alter bytes before parsing.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-024
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-003** — Support 5 Hz GPS Sampling

- **Description:** The GPS library shall deliver received NMEA sentences to the caller at a rate supporting 5 Hz sampling.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-009; library throughput must support the system-mandated 5 Hz GPS sample rate.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-009
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-004** — Non-Blocking Read Interface

- **Description:** The GPS library shall provide a non-blocking read interface that returns within a caller-supplied timeout.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; deterministic execution requires the library never to block the TDM scheduler indefinitely.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-005** — Power-On Self-Test Device Probe

- **Description:** The GPS library shall report at startup whether the GPS receiver is present and responsive.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-029; POST requires probing each sensor device once at startup including the GPS.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-029
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-006** — Continuous GPS Health Reporting

- **Description:** The GPS library shall expose a health indicator reflecting whether NMEA data is flowing from the receiver.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-031; continuous per-sensor health bitmap requires the library to surface its data-flow state.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-031
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-007** — Read Failure Status Reporting

- **Description:** The GPS library shall return a failure status code when a read from the GPS receiver fails.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-031 and supports SW-REQ-SYS-033; explicit failure status enables caller to flag sensor unhealthy and continue.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-031
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-008** — POSIX Implementation Functional Equivalence

- **Description:** The GPS library shall provide a POSIX implementation functionally equivalent to the Pico2 implementation.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation requires POSIX builds that exercise the same library API as flight.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-009** — Pico2 Implementation for Flight Hardware

- **Description:** The GPS library shall provide a Pico2 implementation that reads NMEA sentences from the flight UART.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; flight hardware build requires a Pico2 implementation paired with the POSIX implementation.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-GPS-010** — Preserve Geodetic Position and HAE Altitude

- **Description:** The GPS library shall preserve the receiver's WGS-84 geodetic position and HAE altitude fields in delivered sentences.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-038 and SW-REQ-SYS-039; verbatim pass-through must not corrupt the receiver's native WGS-84 / HAE output.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-039
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
